cat > /tmp/check_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS="us-east-1 us-east-2 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-west-2 eu-west-3 eu-central-1 eu-north-1 ap-northeast-1 ap-northeast-2 ap-northeast-3 ap-southeast-1 ap-southeast-2 ap-south-1 sa-east-1 ca-central-1" # Store all subnets and their regions declare -A subnets_by_region # For each region, get all subnets and network interfaces for region in $REGIONS; do echo "=== Checking region: $region ===" >&2 # Get all subnets in this region aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,AvailabilityZone]' --output text 2>/dev/null | while read subnet_id az; do if [ -n "$subnet_id" ]; then # Get network interface count for this subnet eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text 2>/dev/null) echo "$region|$subnet_id|$az|$eni_count" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_subnets.sh bash /tmp/check_subnets.sh 2>&1

cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS="us-east-1 us-east-2 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-west-2 eu-west-3 eu-central-1 eu-north-1 ap-northeast-1 ap-northeast-2 ap-northeast-3 ap-southeast-1 ap-southeast-2 ap-south-1 sa-east-1 ca-central-1" echo "Collecting subnet and network interface data..." temp_file=$(mktemp) for region in $REGIONS; do aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,AvailabilityZone,VpcId]' --output text 2>/dev/null | while read subnet_id az vpc_id; do if [ -n "$subnet_id" ]; then eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text 2>/dev/null) echo "$region|$subnet_id|$az|$vpc_id|$eni_count" >> "$temp_file" fi done done # Parse and display results echo "Subnets with NO network interfaces:" echo "====================================" echo "" if [ -f "$temp_file" ] && [ -s "$temp_file" ]; then # Sort by region and identify empty subnets sort "$temp_file" | awk -F'|' '$5 == 0 { print "Region: " $1 "
 Subnet ID: " $2 "
 Availability Zone: " $3 "
 VPC ID: " $4 "
" }' | sort -u else echo "No data collected" fi rm -f "$temp_file" EOF chmod +x /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh bash /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh

cat > /tmp/final_report.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash REGIONS="us-east-1 us-east-2 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-west-2 eu-west-3 eu-central-1 eu-north-1 ap-northeast-1 ap-northeast-2 ap-northeast-3 ap-southeast-1 ap-southeast-2 ap-south-1 sa-east-1 ca-central-1" echo "AWS Estate Subnet Analysis - Subnets with No Network Interfaces" echo "==============================================================" echo "" temp_file=$(mktemp) for region in $REGIONS; do aws ec2 describe-subnets --region "$region" --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,AvailabilityZone,VpcId,CidrBlock]' --output text 2>/dev/null | while read subnet_id az vpc_id cidr; do if [ -n "$subnet_id" ]; then eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --region "$region" --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then echo "$region|$subnet_id|$az|$vpc_id|$cidr" fi fi done >> "$temp_file" done if [ -f "$temp_file" ] && [ -s "$temp_file" ]; then # Group by region current_region="" while IFS='|' read region subnet_id az vpc_id cidr; do if [ "$region" != "$current_region" ]; then if [ -n "$current_region" ]; then echo "" fi echo "Region: $region" echo "---" current_region="$region" fi echo " • Subnet: $subnet_id" echo " Availability Zone: $az" echo " VPC: $vpc_id" echo " CIDR: $cidr" done < <(sort "$temp_file") else echo "No subnets without network interfaces found, or all regions have no subnets." fi rm -f "$temp_file" EOF bash /tmp/final_report.sh
